simple.meaning: מֻרְדָּף (murdâph) is a Hebrew action word meaning “persecuted.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Isaiah, beginning at Isaiah 14:6. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מֻרְדָּף (H4783) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: מֻרְדָּף (murdâph) / H4783 is traced through Isaiah 14:6 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.full: H4783. murdaph [ מִרְדָּה ] noun feminine dominion ; — as accusative of congnate meaning with verb חָשָׂ֑ךְ בְּלִי מִרְדַּת Isa 14:6 , construct before clause (Ges § 130d ; so most for מֻרְדָּף ᵑ0 q. v. below רדף ). מֻרְדָּף noun [masculine] persecution (si vera lectio) (formed like Hoph`al Participle ); — Isa 14:6 , but ᵑ7 Thes and most מִרְדַּת q. v.

occurrences.englishText: who struck the peoples in wrath with a continual stroke, who ruled the nations in anger, with a persecution that no one restrained.
